descriptionHtml:
ضمان عام من الوكيل


**Rapoo K10 Numeric Keypad**


**Brand:** Rapoo

**Model:** K10

**Type:** Wired Numeric Keypad

**Color:** Black

**Connection:** Wired (USB)


---


**Key Specifications:**


Number of Keys: 18 keys

Key Type: Scissor-switch (membrane)

Key Layout: Standard numeric keypad + additional function keys

Key Lifecycle: 5 million keystrokes (approx.)


---


**Key Layout:**


Numeric Keys: 0-9

Arithmetic Operators: +, -, *, /

Enter Key: Yes

Num Lock Key: Yes

Decimal Point: Yes (.)

Additional Keys: Tab, Backspace, ESC, 00 (double zero)


---


**Function Keys (Top Row):**


ESC key

Tab key

Backspace key

00 (double zero) key


---


**Interface:**


Connection Type: Wired (USB-A)

Cable Length: 1.5 meters (approx. 5 feet)

Cable Type: Rubber / PVC

Detachable Cable: No (fixed)


---


**Compatibility:**


Operating Systems: Windows 7/8/10/11, macOS, Linux

Laptops: Any laptop with USB-A port

Desktop PCs: Yes

USB-C Devices: Requires USB-A to USB-C adapter


---


**Plug and Play:**


Driver Required: No

Hot-swappable: Yes (plug and use immediately)


---


**Physical Specifications:**


Dimensions: 130 x 85 x 20 mm (approx.)

Weight: 100 - 120 grams

Material: Plastic (ABS)

Non-slip feet: Yes (rubber pads on bottom)


---


**Power:**


Power Source: USB bus-powered (no batteries or external power needed)

Power Consumption: Low (< 100mA)


---


**Features:**


Plug and Play (no driver installation)

Compact and portable design

18 keys including 00 (double zero)

Scissor-switch keys (quiet, laptop-like feel)

Non-slip rubber feet

Lightweight

Compatible with laptops missing numpad


---


**Package Includes:**


Rapoo K10 Numeric Keypad

User manual


---


**Warranty:** 1 year 


---


**Pros:**


Affordable price

Compact and portable

18 keys including 00

Scissor-switch keys (quiet)

Plug and Play

No batteries needed


**Ideal For:**


Laptop users missing numeric keypad

Accountants / bookkeepers

Data entry professionals

Spreadsheet users (Excel, Google Sheets)

Office workers

Students (accounting, finance, math)



---


**Use Cases:**


Excel data entry

Accounting software (QuickBooks, SAP)

Financial calculations

POS systems

Typing numbers quickly

Online banking / number
